description: Saskatoon Accessibility Advisory Committee provides feedback.
On proposed $360 fee for accessible parking stalls.

chips.text: Transportation budget faces $20,000 shortfall for accessible parking.
Stalls remain public despite individual paying installation fee.
Low-income residents may face barriers from proposed fees.
Saskatoon Council on Aging raised concerns about fee affordability.

description: Saskatoon Accessibility Advisory Committee submits 2027 work plan.
Plan focuses on deaf-blind, transit, civic accessibility.

chips.text: Requests $3,000 for educational and awareness materials.
Addresses accessibility for deaf-blind individuals and transit users.

description: Committee reviews its draft 2026 annual report.
Report outlines accomplishments and demonstrates relevance.
It is due to City Council by March 31, 2027.

chips.text: Saskatoon Accessibility Advisory Committee submits its annual report.

description: Committee received current city expenditure statement for information.
Access Transit discussed group booking capacity issues.
Multi-Year Accessibility Plan moves to implementation phase.
Focuses on winter accessibility, city facilities, parks.
City proactively aligns with provincial accessibility standards.

chips.text: Councillor raised concerns about Access Transit's capacity for group bookings.
Staff acknowledged inaccessible QR codes for accessibility plan survey.
Multi-Year Accessibility Plan now guides cross-departmental accessibility improvements.
Multi-Year Accessibility Plan addresses barriers for people with disabilities.
Staff offered to provide more information on accessibility plan to councillors.
